description: This file defines a utility function 'inferColumns' used to generate column configurations for a DataTable component based on the provided data rows and allowlist. It processes data to identify relevant fields, handles date formatting, and returns column definitions suitable for rendering.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Given data rows and an allowlist, returns an array of column definitions for DataTable, ensuring only allowed fields present in the data are included, with special handling for date fields.
